title: Elisha’s Miracles

questions.question: What did the widow have in her house?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:2 (ESV): "...Your servant has nothing in the house except a jar of oil."

questions.question: What miracle happened with the oil?
options: It multiplied to fill many vessels
questions.correctAnswer: It multiplied to fill many vessels
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:6 (ESV): "When the vessels were full... Then the oil stopped flowing."

questions.question: What did the Shunammite woman make for Elisha?
options: A small room on the roof
questions.correctAnswer: A small room on the roof
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:10 (ESV): "Let us make a small room on the roof with walls and put there for him a bed..."

questions.question: What happened to the Shunammite woman's son?
options: He died and Elisha raised him to life
questions.correctAnswer: He died and Elisha raised him to life
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:20, 32-35 (ESV): The child died and Elisha raised him.

questions.question: What was wrong with the stew made for the sons of the prophets?
options: There was death in the pot (poisonous gourds)
questions.correctAnswer: There was death in the pot (poisonous gourds)
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:40 (ESV): "...O man of God, there is death in the pot!"

questions.question: What did Elisha use to fix the poisonous stew?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:41 (ESV): "But he said, 'Then bring flour.' And he threw it into the pot..."

questions.question: How many people were fed with twenty loaves of barley?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:42-44 (ESV): "...Give to the men, that they may eat.... So he set it before them. And they ate and had some left..."

questions.question: What did Elisha prophesy to the Shunammite woman before she conceived?
options: At this season, about this time next year, you shall embrace a son
questions.correctAnswer: At this season, about this time next year, you shall embrace a son
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:16 (ESV): "...At this season, about this time next year, you shall embrace a son."

questions.question: Where was the child when he complained of a headache?
options: With his father among the reapers
questions.correctAnswer: With his father among the reapers
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:18 (ESV): "...he went out to his father to the reapers."

questions.question: Who did Elisha send ahead with his staff?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:29 (ESV): "He said to Gehazi... take my staff in your hand and go..."

questions.question: What did the woman say when asked if it was well with her?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:26 (ESV): "...Is it well with the child?' And she answered, 'It is well.'"

questions.question: How many times did the child sneeze before opening his eyes?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:35 (ESV): "...the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes."

questions.question: What did the servant find in the field to put in the stew?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:39 (ESV): "...and found a wild vine and gathered from it his lap full of wild gourds..."

questions.question: Who brought the bread of the firstfruits?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:42 (ESV): "A man came from Baal-shalishah, bringing the man of God bread of the firstfruits..."

questions.question: Why did the creditor come to the widow?
options: To take her two children to be his slaves
questions.correctAnswer: To take her two children to be his slaves
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 4:1 (ESV): "...and the creditor has come to take my two children to be his slaves."

key_verse_text: But his servant said, “How can I set this before a hundred men?” So he repeated, “Give them to the men, that they may eat, for thus says the LORD, ‘They shall eat and have some left.’” (ESV)
